title: Law Viewer incident as governance case (no product change)
issue_presented: What Governance behavior does the Law Viewer launcher/route issue require, without modifying Law Viewer?

known_facts.fact: Law Viewer is an established operational Runtime (Task 3 ORDER DKT-0020; wire closeout 2026-08-23).
This remediation forbids modifying Law Viewer.

unknown_or_disputed_facts.fact: The precise user-facing launcher/shortcut/route sequence that previously worked for /ninth is not independently reconstructed in this Governance job from runtime evidence beyond ATLAS_RECORD closeout notes.

analysis: If an agent sees unexpected /ninth behavior, adding or changing a route or shortcut without first establishing what previously worked, what served it, what changed, whether current work caused a regression, and what the user relied on, would violate J-0002–J-0004. If evidence remained insufficient, the agent must ask the user a specific question. This Judgment records that duty. It does not change Law Viewer code.
judgment_rule: Law Viewer is an operational system under J-0003.
Unexpected launcher/route behavior requires J-0004 what-changed analysis before any implementation.
If material facts remain UNKNOWN, J-0002 requires USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED — not a new route.
This Governance job MUST NOT modify Law Viewer.
operational_effect: Test E simulates the halt. Law Viewer files are not touched.
required_validation: Test E PASS if engine blocks implementation and emits a specific user question.
